text:
amy-sales: Hi team — customer Stratus wants to kick off a short POC next week. Need to align stakeholders, success criteria, eval prompts, timeline, and any security blockers. cc @jordan-se @lee-eng @raj-security @maria-cust

jordan-se: Thanks — propose a 3-week POC: week 1 intake + infra, week 2 integration + sample evals, week 3 metrics & handoff. Thoughts?

lee-eng: 3 weeks sounds reasonable. What hardware/throughput do they expect? Need that to size Dedicated vs Hosted.

maria-cust: We expect ~5k reqs/day, peak ~20 rps. Primary use case: agent assist (summaries + suggested replies). Data: English support transcripts with some PII — we plan to pre-redact.

raj-security: Quick Qs: do you require SOC2/VPC? Will you be sharing raw transcripts or only redacted data? I'll need the completed security questionnaire — sending template in a sec.

amy-sales: Key success criteria I'm proposing: 1) avg latency p50 < 250ms for generation, 2) summary ROUGE-L >= 0.60 on our eval set, 3) suggested-reply acceptance rate > 30% in A/B, 4) cost target <= $0.02 per 1k tokens. Agree?

maria-cust: :thumbsup: those look good. Can we add uptime requirement 99.5% during business hours (M-F 8am-6pm local)?

jordan-se: Add eval plan: we'll provide 300 annotated examples + 2 prompt templates. Quick example prompt below:
```
System: You are an assistant that summarizes support threads.
User: "<TRANSCRIPT>"
Assistant: "<SUMMARY>"
```
We'll run model outputs vs references and compute ROUGE + a manual review on 50 borderline cases.

lee-eng: Infra options: Hosted (fastest onboarding) using our managed models, or Dedicated (recommended for predictable throughput) with 1xA10x8 baseline. Need token length distribution — what's avg transcript length?

maria-cust: Avg length ~350 tokens, tail up to ~2k for escalations. We can sample 10% for the eval set; will include longer tails.

amy-sales: Open questions for the kickoff meeting:
- Who is the day-to-day technical POC on customer side?
- Do you require encrypted-at-rest keys (KMS/HSM)?
- Confirm sample data pipeline (S3/secure upload).
- Pricing: are you OK with a short reserved trial (committed infra) vs pay-as-you-go?
We'll cover in a 30m kickoff.

maria-cust: Day-to-day contact is @taylor-ops. They require KMS and will provide S3. Preference is pay-as-you-go to start.

raj-security: I'll attach minimal items now: vendor questionnaire, IP & data flow checklist. Also, is there a DPIA needed for EU data? @maria-cust are any EU residents in the sample?

maria-cust: Yes, ~10% EU. We'll flag those records. We'll need the VPC option if EU data is included.

jordan-se: Draft meeting agenda:
1) Intros 5m
2) Success criteria + timeline 10m
3) Data & security requirements 10m
4) Eval prompts + sample data 10m
5) Infra & pricing options 10m
6) Next steps & owners 5m
30m total.

amy-sales: Scheduling: propose Tue 09:30 PT. I'll send calendar invite. Action items before meeting: jordan-se/lee-eng to prepare sample latency/cost estimate; raj-security to attach questionnaire; customer to upload 50 sample transcripts.

deploy-bot: calendar: Invite sent to maria-cust, taylor-ops, jordan-se, lee-eng, raj-security, amy-sales for Tue 09:30 PT.

maria-cust: Received invite, thanks. We'll upload 50 samples by EOD Monday.
